# NGINX — root-to-custom-context

NGINX proxy at /, app on /app context. The proxy adds the /app prefix when forwarding to the backend's custom context — scenario-local template with proxy_cookie_path and proxy_redirect adjustments.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

NGINX template (`nginx/http/root-to-custom-context/default.conf.template`):

```nginx
# Mapping used to populate the 'Connection' header
# If $http_upgrade has a not blank value, then $connection_upgrade is set to 'upgrade',
# otherwise value will be 'close'
map $http_upgrade $connection_upgrade {
    default upgrade;
    '' close;
}

server {

    listen       80;
    server_name  localhost;

    location / {
        proxy_set_header        Host $host;
        proxy_set_header        X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header        X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header        X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header        Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header        Connection $connection_upgrade;

        # Vaadin PUSH streams its response. Without an HTTP/1.1 upstream
        # and buffering turned off, nginx holds each SSE event until its
        # buffer fills; the timeout covers the 60s PUSH heartbeat.
        proxy_http_version      1.1;
        proxy_buffering         off;
        proxy_read_timeout      300s;

        proxy_pass http://vaadin:8080/app/;
        proxy_redirect $scheme://$host/app/ $scheme://$http_host/;
        proxy_cookie_path /app /;
    }
}
```
